Question 10
?

Find the global extrema of the function f(x,y)=x2+y2−2x−1 on the closed region D={(x,y):x2+y2≤4}. You are given that the function has a critical point at (1,0)∈D.

a
fmin=2 and fmax=7
b
fmin=−7 and fmax=−1
c
fmin=−1 and fmax=7
d
fmin=−2 and fmax=−1
e
fmin=−2 and fmax=7
